# PRs Listed are Only Merged PRs

Only pull requests that have been merged into the base branch and after a specified datetime are listed as merged PRs.

To guarantee that listed PRs genuinely affect the codebase and to avoid processing open/unmerged PRs.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/collectors/forge.py` — `knowledge_compiler.collectors.forge.ForgeGateway.list_merged_prs`
- `knowledge_compiler/collectors/forge.py` — `knowledge_compiler.collectors.forge.GitHubGateway.list_merged_prs`
- `knowledge_compiler/collectors/forge.py` — `knowledge_compiler.collectors.forge.FakeForge.list_merged_prs`
